user.title: Add a WeChat Publisher account
user.description:
Enter the AppID and AppSecret of your Official Account or Mini Program.

⚠️ Add the outbound IP of your Home Assistant server to WeChat's IP whitelist first (Settings & Development → Basic Configuration → IP Whitelist). The IP detected just now is: **{ip}**

Add one entry per account; you can add as many as you like.

data_description.account_name: Only used to tell accounts apart inside Home Assistant
data_description.account_type: Choose Official Account or Mini Program
data_description.appid: AppID from Settings & Development → Basic Configuration
data_description.appsecret: AppSecret on the same page; it is only shown once

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description:
The credentials for **{name}** (AppID: {appid}) are no longer valid. Enter the AppSecret again.

If you see an IP whitelist error, add **{ip}** to the IP whitelist in the WeChat console.

error.invalid_ip: Server IP {ip} is not in the IP whitelist. Add it in the WeChat console and retry
error.not_publisher: This account has not enabled the Publisher (流量主) programme yet
error.rate_limited: WeChat API rate limit reached, please try again later
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the WeChat API, check your network
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant logs

abort.already_configured: This AppID has already been added
abort.reauth_failed: Re-authentication failed, please add the account again
